raw_text: IT EN DE MENU HOME / PROPERTIES / APPARTAMENTI TRILOCALI CON TERRAZZA O GIARDINO PRIVATO A JESOLO FOR SALE · APARTMENT Appartamenti Trilocali con Terrazza o Giardino Privato a Jesolo PIAZZA MARCONI - DRAGO · JESOLO · VENEZIA PRICE €375,000 Photos (27) Floor plans (0) 1 / 27 FLOOR AREA 90 m² BEDROOMS 2 BATHROOMS 1 LIFT No ENERGY CLASS A3 Overview Welcome to your new home in Jesolo! In the most authentic and sought-after heart of Jesolo, just a few steps from the central Piazza Drago and only 400 meters from the sea, stands Residence EQUILIUM. This exclusive residential context, completed in 2022 and consisting of only 6 housing units, has been designed for those who wish to live in the city center without sacrificing tranquility. The structure is distinguished by high construction standards classified as energy class A3 and the use of cutting-edge technologies, including a heat pump system that ensures excellent living comfort throughout every season of the year and lasting value over time. Within this Residence, we offer four three-room apartments for sale, characterized by impeccable and functional internal space distribution. Each unit opens onto a generous and bright living area with an open-space living room and kitchen, designed as the heart of the home. The sleeping area includes a spacious master bedroom, a comfortable single bedroom, a modern bathroom, and an essential storage room. Exclusive ground floor solution: this apartment features a private garden perfect for enjoying moments of relaxation outdoors and comes with two parking spaces equipped with charging stations. Offered at a price of €375,000 (unfurnished). Three units on the first floor: all featuring a splendid private solarium terrace measuring 45 sqm along with an uncovered parking space equipped with electric vehicle charging station. Depending on exposure and desired furnishing options you can choose between an unfurnished variant at €440,000 North exposure or opt for maximum convenience with furnished options starting at €460,000 where one highlights is already furnished central unit. Each first-floor solution is complemented by an uncovered parking space already prepared for electric vehicle charging. The sale is subject to registration tax. The sale comes from individuals. A concrete real estate proposal attended to detail ready to be lived in the heart of Jesolo Lido. Contact us for more information or to schedule a visit.
